categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang FORE Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of small module steel gears, pneumatic tools, precision reducers (including harmonic reducers) and related components, as well as new energy transmission products. Their products serve industries such as new energy vehicles, robotics (including humanoid robots), smart home devices, medical equipment, electric tools, and power station remote control systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced gear manufacturing technologies including cutting, precision forging, and powder metallurgy, with a focus on cutting-edge gear processing like hard tooth surface cutting to improve precision and reduce noise. They have proprietary R&D capabilities covering gear design, tooling, CNC milling, and quality control, supported by high-end equipment from Germany and Japan. They also develop customized precision reducers such as harmonic and planetary reducers for robotics and automotive applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading multinational companies in the electric tool sector such as Bosch, Stanley Black & Decker, Makita, Techtronic Industries, and Metabo. The company serves diverse markets including electric tools, smart home devices, new energy vehicles, industrial and humanoid robots, medical devices, and agricultural machinery. Their products are integrated into high-end applications like automotive power transmission, robotic joints, and smart home actuators.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, accounting for about 55% of revenue, and maintains a substantial international presence with approximately 45% of sales overseas. It has subsidiaries in Germany and Singapore to support global operations and supply chains. The company is listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and actively develops markets in Europe and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang FORE Intelligent Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing critical components such as gears and precision reducers that are essential parts for downstream equipment manufacturers in automotive, robotics, and smart home industries. They procure raw materials like steel and forgings upstream and supply finished components directly to OEMs and system integrators downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with sustained R&D investment, focusing on enhancing precision, noise reduction, and efficiency of gear and reducer products. Key R&D directions include harmonic reducers for humanoid robots, high-precision transmission gears for new energy vehicles, and automation in production processes. They aim to expand product lines into emerging fields such as industrial and service robots, smart home devices, and automotive intelligent drive systems, supported by patent development and national technology projects.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of physical products including gears, precision reducers, pneumatic tools, and new energy transmission components. The company employs a direct sales model for most products and a distribution model for pneumatic tools. Revenue recognition is based on product delivery and customer acceptance, with contracts typically involving upfront purchase orders and real-time orders.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer in the small module gear and precision reducer market, recognized as a national 'specialized and innovative' 'little giant' and manufacturing champion. It competes with international brands in high-end gear and reducer segments but leverages cost advantages and customization capabilities to serve major global clients. Its stable partnerships with top-tier multinational customers position it strongly in the midstream component supply chain.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 504.7 million, a 17.56% increase over the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 16.8 million, reflecting a 30.28% decrease due to increased costs and investments. Total assets reached RMB 1.31 billion, growing 7.46% year-over-year. The company is in a growth phase, expanding production capacity and investing heavily in R&D and new business segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang FORE Intelligent Technology emphasizes high precision, reliability, and customization in its gear and reducer products, supported by advanced manufacturing and quality control systems certified to international standards (ISO9001, IATF16949). Its products offer superior performance in noise reduction, durability, and efficiency, tailored to demanding applications in robotics, new energy vehicles, and smart home devices. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and close collaboration with global leading customers enhance its competitive differentiation.
